verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a TypeScript authentication framework, not an agent that calls tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. The MCP evidence in the pack covers different roles: an OAuth authorization server for MCP clients, and a vendor-hosted docs MCP server. Neither is client-side tool consumption, so neither makes this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
